# External Test Data Integration - Official DAWProject Repository

**Document**: External Test Data Integration Plan  
**Phase**: 05-Implementation  
**Date**: October 10, 2025  
**Status**: External Authority Test Integration Required  
**Authority**: Official DAWProject Repository

---

## 🎯 External Test Data Sources Identified

### Official DAWProject Test Data Repository

**Primary Source**: https://github.com/bitwig/dawproject  
**Test Data Location**: `src/test-data/` directory  
**Generated Schemas**: Project.xsd and MetaData.xsd (generated by Java tests)  
**Test Framework**: Java-based test suite with parameterized tests

### External Test Files Available

Based on repository analysis, the official DAWProject repository contains:

1. **Test Data Directory**: `src/test-data/`
   - Contains `.dawproject` files for validation testing
   - Used by `LoadDawProjectTest.java` for parameterized testing
   - Includes various scenarios: audio clips, MIDI automation, complex projects

2. **Generated XSD Schemas**:
   - `Project.xsd` - Generated by `DawProjectTest.writeProjectSchema()`
   - `MetaData.xsd` - Generated by `DawProjectTest.writeMetadataSchema()`
   - These are authoritative schemas for validation

3. **Example DAWProject Files**:
   - Audio scenarios: warped, raw beats, raw seconds, file paths
   - MIDI automation: CC1, pitch bend, in clips vs on tracks  
   - Complex projects with multiple features
   - Simple projects for basic validation

## 🔧 Required External Test Data Integration

### 1. External Test Data Manager Implementation

**New Required Component**:

```cpp
namespace dawproject::testing {

class ExternalTestDataManager {
public:
    // Download official test files from external repository
    Result<std::vector<std::filesystem::path>> downloadOfficialTestFiles();
    
    // Get specific test file from external repository
    Result<std::filesystem::path> getOfficialTestFile(const std::string& testFileName);
    
    // Download and cache external XSD schemas
    Result<std::filesystem::path> downloadProjectXSD();
    Result<std::filesystem::path> downloadMetaDataXSD();
    
    // Validate against official test files
    ValidationResult validateAgainstOfficialTests();
    
    // Get test file URLs from external repository
    std::vector<std::string> getOfficialTestFileURLs();
    
private:
    // External authority URLs - NEVER INTERNALIZE
    static constexpr const char* REPO_BASE_URL = 
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitwig/dawproject/main/";
    static constexpr const char* TEST_DATA_BASE_URL = 
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitwig/dawproject/main/src/test-data/";
    static constexpr const char* PROJECT_XSD_URL = 
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitwig/dawproject/main/Project.xsd";
    static constexpr const char* METADATA_XSD_URL = 
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bitwig/dawproject/main/MetaData.xsd";
        
    std::filesystem::path m_testDataCache;
    std::filesystem::path m_schemaCache;
    std::chrono::system_clock::time_point m_lastUpdate;
    
    // Network operations for external authority access
    Result<std::vector<uint8_t>> downloadFile(const std::string& url);
    Result<void> cacheFile(const std::string& url, const std::filesystem::path& localPath);
};

} // namespace dawproject::testing
```

### 2. External Authority Test Framework

**Integration with Current Test Structure**:

```cpp
namespace dawproject::testing {

class ExternalAuthorityTestSuite {
public:
    // Test against official DAWProject test files
    struct ExternalTestResults {
        std::vector<ValidationResult> loadTests;
        std::vector<ValidationResult> saveTests;
        std::vector<ValidationResult> schemaValidationTests;
        ValidationResult overallCompliance;
    };
    
    // Run complete external authority test suite
    ExternalTestResults runExternalComplianceTests();
    
    // Test loading official DAWProject files
    ValidationResult testLoadOfficialFiles();
    
    // Test schema validation against external XSD
    ValidationResult testExternalSchemaValidation();
    
    // Test round-trip compatibility (load -> save -> load)
    ValidationResult testRoundTripCompatibility();
    
    // Test interoperability file generation
    ValidationResult testInteroperabilityFileGeneration();
    
private:
    std::unique_ptr<ExternalTestDataManager> m_testDataManager;
    std::unique_ptr<XMLProcessorImpl> m_xmlProcessor;
    std::unique_ptr<ZipProcessor> m_zipProcessor;
};

} // namespace dawproject::testing
```

### 5. External Schema Integration for Testing

**Schema Download and Validation**:

```cpp
namespace dawproject::testing {

class ExternalSchemaValidator {
public:
    // Download and cache external schemas
    Result<void> updateExternalSchemas();
    
    // Validate XML against external Project.xsd
    ValidationResult validateProjectXML(const std::string& xmlContent);
    
    // Validate XML against external MetaData.xsd  
    ValidationResult validateMetaDataXML(const std::string& xmlContent);
    
    // Validate complete .dawproject file against external authority
    ValidationResult validateDawProjectFile(const std::filesystem::path& dawprojectPath);
    
    // Check if external schemas are available and current
    Result<bool> checkExternalSchemaAvailability();
    
private:
    std::filesystem::path m_projectXSDCache;
    std::filesystem::path m_metaDataXSDCache;
    std::chrono::system_clock::time_point m_lastSchemaUpdate;
    
    // libxml2 integration for XSD validation
    ValidationResult performXSDValidation(
        const std::string& xmlContent, 
        const std::filesystem::path& xsdPath);
};

} // namespace dawproject::testing
```

## 📋 External Test Integration Checklist

### External Test Data Setup

- [ ] **Create ExternalTestDataManager**: Download and cache official test files at runtime
- [ ] **Download Project.xsd**: Cache external Project schema for validation testing
- [ ] **Download MetaData.xsd**: Cache external MetaData schema for validation testing  
- [ ] **Download Official Test Files**: Cache all .dawproject files from official repository
- [ ] **Network Error Handling**: Graceful fallback when external sources unavailable
- [ ] **Cache Management**: Local cache with update checking and expiration

### External Authority Test Suite

- [ ] **External Schema Validation Tests**: Test against downloaded Project.xsd and MetaData.xsd
- [ ] **Official Test File Loading**: Load and parse all official .dawproject test files
- [ ] **Round-Trip Compatibility Tests**: Load official files, save them, reload and verify
- [ ] **Interoperability Generation Tests**: Generate files compatible with external DAWs
- [ ] **Schema Compliance Tests**: Validate all generated files against external schemas
- [ ] **External Authority Integration**: Ensure tests fail if external authority is unavailable

### Test Infrastructure Updates

- [ ] **Add External Test Directories**: Create directory structure for external test data
- [ ] **Update CMakeLists.txt**: Add external test dependencies and targets
- [ ] **Add Network Dependencies**: Include HTTP client library for downloading test data
- [ ] **Add External Test Targets**: CMake targets for running external authority tests
- [ ] **CI/CD Integration**: Include external authority tests in automated testing pipeline
- [ ] **Documentation Updates**: Document external test data integration and usage

### External Authority Compliance

- [ ] **No Internal Test Copies**: Ensure NO internal copies of external test files
- [ ] **Runtime Download Only**: All external test data downloaded at runtime
- [ ] **External Schema Authority**: Use only downloaded external XSD schemas for validation
- [ ] **Official Repository References**: All test data references point to external repository
- [ ] **External Authority Documentation**: Clear documentation of external dependencies

## 🎯 External Test Implementation Plan

### Phase 1: External Authority Infrastructure (P0)

1. **Implement ExternalTestDataManager**: Core component for downloading and caching external test data
2. **Add Network Dependencies**: Include HTTP client library (libcurl or similar) for external downloads
3. **Create External Cache Structure**: Directory structure for caching external schemas and test files
4. **Implement External Schema Validator**: libxml2 integration for XSD validation against external schemas

### Phase 2: Official Test File Integration (P1)

1. **Download Official Test Files**: Implement download and caching of all .dawproject files from repository
2. **Integrate External Test Suite**: Create test suite that loads and validates official test files
3. **Round-Trip Compatibility Testing**: Test loading official files, saving them, and reloading
4. **External Schema Validation Testing**: Validate all operations against external Project.xsd and MetaData.xsd

### Phase 3: Interoperability Testing (P2) 

1. **External DAW Compatibility**: Generate files that work in Bitwig Studio and PreSonus Studio One
2. **Official Test File Analysis**: Analyze structure and features of official test files for compliance
3. **Comprehensive External Testing**: Full test suite against external authority with detailed reporting
4. **CI/CD Integration**: Include external authority tests in automated build and test pipeline

## 🚫 Critical External Authority Rules

### NEVER Do ❌

- **NEVER** copy external test files into the repository
- **NEVER** internalize external XSD schemas  
- **NEVER** create internal copies of official test data
- **NEVER** modify external test files or schemas
- **NEVER** assume external test data structure

### ALWAYS Do ✅

- **ALWAYS** download test data at runtime from external authority
- **ALWAYS** use external XSD schemas for validation
- **ALWAYS** reference external repository URLs in test documentation
- **ALWAYS** fail tests gracefully when external authority unavailable
- **ALWAYS** validate against external schemas, never internal assumptions
